title: Cognizant × AMF1 Singapore STEM Lab
subtitle: Hands-on data analytics & aerodynamics workshop for secondary students
description: Hosted in Singapore leading up to the Marina Bay GP, this initiative pairs Cognizant data scientists and AMF1 race engineers with underrepresented students in Singapore to code live telemetry and analyze track grip coefficients.

title: DHL Global SAF Logistics Corridor
subtitle: Decarbonizing transcontinental flyaway freight via certified SAFc
description: Aston Martin Aramco deploys Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc) in partnership with DHL Global Forwarding to cut lifecycle aviation freight emissions by over 80% on long-haul charter flights.

title: Make A Mark Engineering Mentorship
subtitle: Accelerating underrepresented engineering talent into Formula One
description: Direct one-on-one mentorship pairing female and ethnic minority university engineering undergraduates with senior vehicle dynamics and aerodynamic engineers at the Silverstone Technology Campus.
